method: beat sheet -> manifest; no generated footage, no extra shots

continuity.note: x is the declared stage position; a change is allowed only when the shot's motive explains it

performance.note: compound actions are ordered phases of existing presets, not a second animation system

shots.cameraMotive: start on the silent bell and reveal its size before we meet the man who refused it
shots.transitionMotive: open on the object, not on an establishing shot
shots.line: Aquella noche, el guardián no tocó la campana.

shots.cameraMotive: follow the two men across the square so the empty bell has a human scale
shots.transitionMotive: the bell gives way to the square and the two men who disagree about it
shots.line: El pueblo llevaba tres inviernos sin oírla.

shots.cameraMotive: move with the rope hand so the climb is an action, not an illustration
shots.transitionMotive: cut on the reaching hand: the action continues
shots.line: El aprendiz subió al campanario con una cuerda.

shots.cameraMotive: hold the reaction without moving: the performance is the event
shots.transitionMotive: hard cut into the keeper's judgement; no dissolve softens it

shots.cameraMotive: reframe around the pointing hand so the missing rope becomes the subject
shots.transitionMotive: from the keeper's silence to the gesture that answers it
shots.line: El aprendiz señaló la cuerda que faltaba.

shots.cameraMotive: release the frame to the graveyard and let the empty space carry the unanswered question
shots.transitionMotive: night yields to first light: a deliberate change of time and place
shots.line: Desde entonces, el silencio tuvo fecha.
